_comment: Labeled parse-quality cases. expected = grants the parser should produce; forbidden = grants that must never appear (resource null = any resource for that tool). Tags: smoke (fast live subset), ambiguous (null resource is correct), injection (pasted untrusted content), tricky, out-of-scope, no-op.
